name: Decline Crunch
steps: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms on your chest or rest fingertips beside your head.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders off the bench.
Pause, then lower slowly without resting at the bottom.
cues: Lower back pressed into the bench
Breathe out as you curl up

common_mistakes.fix: Cross the arms on the chest
